map.由零件变差与测量误差求可区分类别数: Find the number of distinct categories from part variation and measurement error
map.输入零件间变差 PV 与测量系统误差 GRR，求 NDC。: Enter the part-to-part variation PV and the measurement system error GRR to get NDC.
map.📖 查看「由零件变差与测量误差求可区分类别数 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the number of distinct categories from part variation and measurement error"

map.📚 深度解析：可区分类别数 (NDC): 📚 Deep Dive: Number of distinct categories (NDC)
map.NDC = 1.41*(PV/GRR)。例：过程变异 PV=0.02、GRR=0: NDC = 1.41*(PV/GRR). Example: process variation PV=0.02, GRR=0.0028 gives NDC = 1.41*7.14 ≈ 10.
map.NDC=1.41×6.5/0.8=11.46，远大于 5，说明该测量系统足以分辨: NDC = 1.41 x 6.5/0.8 = 11.46, well above 5, so this measurement system resolves the true differences between parts.
map.NDC≥5 量具足够分辨过程变异。: NDC ≥ 5 means the gage resolves process variation well enough.
map.需提高分辨率或换量具。: Improve the resolution or change the gage.
map.测量系统 NDC（本页代码口径）：NDC=1.41×零件变差 PV÷测量系统变差: Measurement system NDC (this page's code basis): NDC = 1.41×part variation PV ÷ measurement system variation GRR (number of distinct categories, 2 decimals); linked values: GRR share of process variation = GRR÷PV×100 (%, denominator floored at 10⁻¹²), PV÷GRR ratio, NDC rounded down. Validation: empty input in either field prompts and stops. Criteria: the page has no threshold branches; the common reading is NDC ≥ 5 for an acceptable measurement system, otherwise reduce measurement variation.
